works.title: James Roberts Medical Negligence Complaint
works.description: A structured formal medical negligence complaint document addressing systemic healthcare failures and provider malpractice. The complaint examines violations by Dr. Rupinder Mann and IPMG institutional failures, with organized sections documenting provider conduct, impacts on patient James Roberts, and exhibits of supporting evidence.
works.quote: We are reviewing the supporting documents for the James Roberts complaint one by one to ensure there are no contradictions with the main document
